Minggu ini, jalan kaki 10 minit waktu rehat tengah hari atau selepas ambil anak dari sekolah, 5 hari. Lebih 20 kg ialah perjalanan berbulan-bulan, jadi bina tabiat dulu sebelum tambah intensiti.
20+|3|Workout.en: Wanting more energy for your kids and your job is a lovely reason, and moving a little every day is the easiest place to start. This week, take a 10-minute walk at lunch or after school pickup, 5 days. 20+ kg is a months-long journey, so build the habit before building intensity.

20+|3|Mindset & Method.ms: Tenaga untuk keluarga dan kerja banyak bergantung pada tidur dan stres, jadi kita mula di situ, bukan dengan diet ketat lagi. Minggu ini, set alarm waktu tidur dan bila stres memuncak, ambil 5 minit bernafas tenang atau jalan sekejap sebelum capai snek. Pada anggaran 0.5-1 kg seminggu ini ambil masa berbulan-bulan, dan diri yang cukup rehat lebih senang untuk teruskan.
20+|3|Mindset & Method.en: Energy for family and work depends a lot on sleep and stress, so that's where we start, not with another strict diet. This week, set a bedtime alarm, and when stress peaks take 5 minutes of calm breathing or a short walk before reaching for a snack. At about 0.5-1 kg a week this takes months, and a rested you will find it easier to keep going.

20+|3|none.ms: Tabiat baik dah ada, jadi untuk lebih bertenaga bagi keluarga dan kerja, kita cuma ketatkan beberapa butiran. Minggu ini, tambah satu genggam protein dalam setiap hidangan dan jalan kaki 15 minit, 4 hari. Jangkakan anggaran 0.5-1 kg seminggu selama beberapa bulan, dan catat tahap tenaga anda juga, bukan berat saja.
20+|3|none.en: The good habits are already there, so more energy for family and work is about tightening a few details. This week, add a fist of protein to every meal and walk 15 minutes on 4 days. Expect about 0.5-1 kg a week over several months, and track your energy levels too, not just your weight.

20+|4|Nutrition.ms: Orang yang sayang anda, mungkin doktor anda, dah beri dorongan, jadi jadikan ini matlamat anda sendiri juga dan teruskan ikut nasihat doktor. Minggu ini, hadkan makanan bergoreng waktu tengah hari kepada 3 hari, dan hari lain pilih bakar, kukus atau sup, macam ayam bakar atau sup sayur. Lebih 20 kg pada anggaran 0.5-1 kg seminggu ialah matlamat berbulan-bulan, dan itu memang okay.
20+|4|Nutrition.en: Someone who cares about you, maybe your doctor, gave you a nudge, so let's make this your own goal too, and keep following your doctor's advice. This week, limit fried food at lunch to 3 days, and on the others pick grilled, steamed or soup options like ayam bakar or sup sayur. 20+ kg at about 0.5-1 kg a week is a months-long goal, and that's perfectly fine.

20+|4|Workout.ms: Bila orang tersayang atau doktor bersuara, itu tanda mereka nak anda sihat lama, jadi teruskan ikut nasihat doktor tentang apa yang selamat untuk anda. Minggu ini, pilih 3 hari tetap untuk jalan kaki 15 minit dan ajak orang itu temankan anda. Berbulan-bulan bergerak secara konsisten lebih bermakna daripada satu minggu yang berat.
20+|4|Workout.en: When a loved one or your doctor speaks up, it's because they want you well for a long time, so keep following your doctor's advice on what's safe for you. This week, pick 3 fixed days for a 15-minute walk and invite that person to join you. Months of steady movement matter more than one hard week.

20+|4|Mindset & Method.ms: Disuruh turunkan berat boleh rasa berat di hati, lebih-lebih lagi bila percubaan dulu tak kekal, jadi kali ini kita mula kecil dan anda teruskan ikut nasihat doktor. Minggu ini, tulis kenapa ini penting untuk anda sendiri dan tampal di peti sejuk, kemudian cuba tidur pada waktu sama setiap malam. 20 kg akan ambil masa berbulan-bulan, dan rentak perlahan itu memang plan, bukan kegagalan.
20+|4|Mindset & Method.en: Being told to lose weight can feel heavy, especially when past tries didn't stick, so this time we start small and you keep following your doctor's advice. This week, write down why this matters to you personally and stick it on the fridge, then aim to sleep at the same time each night. Twenty kilos will take months, and that slow pace is the plan, not a failure.

20+|4|none.ms: Tabiat anda dah agak baik, jadi nasihat yang anda terima lebih mudah dilaksanakan, dan teruskan ikut panduan doktor sepanjang jalan. Minggu ini, ambil gambar semua yang anda makan selama 7 hari supaya kita boleh nampak ruang untuk perubahan kecil. Anggaran 0.5-1 kg seminggu adalah realistik, jadi rancang untuk beberapa bulan.
20+|4|none.en: Your habits are already decent, which makes the advice you got easier to act on, and keep following your doctor's guidance along the way. This week, snap a photo of everything you eat for 7 days so we can spot room for small changes. About 0.5-1 kg a week is realistic, so plan for several months.

health|1|Nutrition.en: Wanting to feel confident and fit your old clothes again is a real reason, and more energy shows in how you carry yourself. Give it a few weeks; clothes often feel different before the scale shows much.

health|1|Mindset & Method.ms: Rasa yakin bermula dengan badan yang cukup rehat, bukan hanya rupa di cermin. Minggu ini, sasarkan tidur 7 jam pada hari bekerja dan tulis satu kemenangan kecil setiap hari. Jangan nilai diri dengan cubaan lepas, kali ini kita bina perlahan-lahan supaya kekal.
health|1|Mindset & Method.en: Feeling confident starts with feeling rested, not just how you look in the mirror. This week, aim for 7 hours of sleep on weeknights and write down one small win each day. Don't judge yourself by past attempts; this time we build slowly so it lasts.

health|1|none.ms: Tabiat anda dah okay, jadi nak muat baju lama semula ini soal perhalusi, bukan mula dari kosong. Minggu ini, cuba satu baju kegemaran dan catat rasanya, kemudian tambah lebih kurang 2,000 langkah sehari. Cuba semula selepas 4 minggu, perubahan perlahan biasanya yang paling kekal.
health|1|none.en: Your habits are decent, so fitting your old clothes again is about fine-tuning, not starting over. This week, try on one favourite piece and note how it fits, then add about 2,000 extra steps a day. Try it again in 4 weeks; slow change is usually the change that stays.

health|2|Nutrition.ms: Majlis besar anda beri satu tarikh yang jelas, jadi kita rancang ke belakang supaya anda segar dan bertenaga pada hari itu. Mulakan minggu ini: satu minuman manis sehari jadi kurang manis atau air kosong, dan sasarkan 6 hingga 8 gelas air. Minggu-minggu yang konsisten sebelum majlis lebih berkesan daripada diet terburu-buru saat akhir.
health|2|Nutrition.en: Your big event gives you a clear date, so we plan backwards to have you feeling fresh and energetic on the day. Start this week: one sweet drink a day becomes less sweet or plain water, and aim for 6 to 8 glasses of water. Steady weeks before the event work better than a rushed last-minute diet.

health|2|Workout.ms: Dengan majlis yang semakin dekat, kira minggu yang tinggal dan rancang ke belakang supaya anda ada tenaga untuk enjoy hari itu. Minggu ini, masukkan 3 sesi 20 minit dalam kalendar macam mesyuarat, sama ada jalan laju atau senaman di rumah. Hadir 3 kali seminggu sampai hari majlis pun dah cukup.
health|2|Workout.en: With your event getting closer, count the weeks left and plan backwards so you have the energy to enjoy the day. This week, put 3 sessions of 20 minutes in your calendar like meetings, either a brisk walk or a home workout. Showing up 3 times a week until the day is enough.

health|2|Mindset & Method.ms: Tarikh majlis anda dah tetap, jadi kita rancang ke belakang dengan tenang, bukan dengan tekanan. Perkara pertama, jaga tidur minggu ini: waktu tidur sama setiap malam dan tak scroll telefon atas katil. Diri yang cukup rehat akan nampak dan rasa lebih baik pada hari itu berbanding diri yang penat dan stres.

health|2|none.ms: Tabiat yang baik ditambah tarikh yang jelas memang gabungan yang bagus, rancang ke belakang dan anda akan tiba dalam keadaan terbaik. Minggu ini, tambah satu sumber protein di setiap hidangan, seperti telur, ikan, ayam atau tauhu, supaya kenyang lebih lama dan tenaga stabil. Kekalkan rentak ini minggu demi minggu sampai hari majlis.
health|2|none.en: Good habits plus a clear date is a great combo; plan backwards and you'll arrive at your best. This week, add one protein to every meal, like egg, fish, chicken or tofu, so you stay full longer with steady energy. Keep this rhythm week by week right up to the day.

health|3|Nutrition.ms: Mahu tenaga untuk keluarga dan kerja adalah sebab yang kuat, dan makanan ialah bahan bakar untuk kedua-duanya. health|3|Nutrition.en: Wanting energy for your family and work is a strong reason, and food is the fuel for both. First fix: don't skip lunch, and pair your rice with protein and vegetables, not just fried items. Many people notice steadier energy within 2 to 3 weeks.

health|3|Workout.en: Energy for your kids and your job usually comes from moving more, not resting more. This week, take a 10-minute walk after lunch at the office or with the kids in the evening, 5 days. Short and frequent beats long and rare.

health|3|Mindset & Method.ms: Anda mahu tenaga untuk orang yang bergantung pada anda, jadi anda juga perlu cas semula. Minggu ini, elakkan kopi selepas pukul 3 petang dan tidur 30 minit lebih awal pada 4 malam. Bila cukup rehat, lebih mudah untuk kekal dengan tabiat lain.
health|3|Mindset & Method.en: You want energy for the people who count on you, so you need to recharge too. This week, avoid coffee after 3pm and go to bed 30 minutes earlier on 4 nights. When you're well rested, it's easier to stick with everything else.

health|3|none.ms: Tabiat anda dah kukuh, jadi tenaga lebih untuk keluarga dan kerja ini soal naik taraf kecil. Minggu ini, buat regangan 5 minit setiap pagi dan minum segelas air sebelum kopi pertama. Teruskan selama sebulan dan perhatikan beza tenaga anda waktu petang.
health|3|none.en: Your habits are solid, so more energy for family and work comes from small upgrades. This week, do a 5-minute stretch every morning and drink a glass of water before your first coffee. Keep it up for a month and notice how your afternoons feel.

health|4|Workout.ms: Doktor atau orang terdekat mahu anda lebih sihat, dan lebih banyak bergerak adalah cara paling mudah untuk bermula. health|4|Mindset & Method.ms: Bila disuruh berubah oleh doktor atau keluarga, ia boleh terasa berat, jadi mari jadikan ia matlamat anda sendiri, selangkah demi selangkah. Minggu ini, tetapkan waktu tidur dan bangun yang sama dan kekalkan selama 5 hari. Teruskan ikut nasihat doktor anda, dan cubaan lepas yang tak kekal cuma tanda kita perlu mula lebih kecil.
health|4|Mindset & Method.en: Being told to change by a doctor or family can feel heavy, so let's make it your own goal, one step at a time. This week, set the same sleep and wake time and keep it for 5 days. Keep following your doctor's advice; past attempts that didn't stick just tell us to start smaller.

health|4|none.ms: Orang terdekat atau doktor minta anda jaga kesihatan, dan tabiat anda yang dah baik beri permulaan yang kukuh. health|4|none.en: Someone close or your doctor asked you to look after your health, and your already-decent habits give you a solid head start. This week, jot down what you eat and how you feel for 5 days so we can see what to tweak. Keep following your doctor's advice and attend every follow-up appointment.

gain|1|Nutrition.en: Wanting your shirts to fit properly instead of hanging loose is a great reason, and it starts with food. Beri masa beberapa bulan latihan konsisten, waktu itulah perubahan pada baju biasanya mula nampak.
gain|1|Workout.en: Filling out your clothes comes mostly from muscle on your shoulders, chest, back and legs, not just extra kilos. This week, start with three simple moves, push-ups (knees are fine), squats and rows with a water bottle or bag, twice. Give it a few months of steady training, which is usually when changes in how clothes fit show up.

gain|1|Mindset & Method.ms: Yakin diri tumbuh bila anda nampak diri sendiri tepati janji, jadi kali ini kita mula kecil. gain|1|Mindset & Method.en: Confidence grows when you see yourself keeping promises, so this time we start small. Fix sleep first: aim for 7 hours and the same wake-up time, even on weekends, so you have energy to eat and train. Slow progress you can repeat is what finally sticks.

gain|1|none.ms: Anda nak rasa selesa dan yakin dalam baju sendiri, dan tiada kelemahan besar, jadi boleh terus mula. Lepas itu, sasarkan kenaikan perlahan dan konsisten dengan latihan kekuatan 2-3 kali seminggu.
gain|1|none.en: You want to feel good in your clothes, and nothing major is holding you back, so you can start right away. This week, take front and side photos in a fitted shirt, because mirror changes often show before the scale does. Then aim for slow, steady gain with strength training 2-3 times a week.

gain|2|Nutrition.ms: Majlis anda beri kita tarikh untuk rancang ke belakang, jadi setiap minggu mulai sekarang penting. Minggu ini, tetapkan tiga kali makan dan satu snek pada waktu yang tetap, dengan protein setiap kali, contohnya ayam, telur, ikan atau tempe. Naik berat memang perlahan, jadi badan lebih berisi pada hari majlis datang daripada minggu-minggu yang konsisten, bukan makan banyak saat akhir.
gain|2|Nutrition.en: Your event gives us a date to plan backwards from, so every week from now counts. This week, set three meals and one snack at fixed times, with protein each time, like chicken, eggs, fish or tempeh. Gaining is slow, so a fuller look on the day comes from steady weeks, not last-minute feasting.

gain|2|Workout.en: With your event on the calendar, count the weeks you have and fill them with strength training. This week, book two 30-minute sessions in your diary, squats, push-ups and rows, and treat them like an important meeting. Muscle builds slowly, so starting now matters more than training hard.

gain|2|Mindset & Method.ms: Tarikh majlis memang motivasi yang kuat, tapi plan anda kena tahan minggu sibuk dan stres. Cubaan lepas mungkin terhenti, tapi plan yang lebih ringkas lebih mudah bertahan sampai hari majlis.

This week, pick one way to release stress, like a 10-minute walk after dinner, and protect 7 hours of sleep. Past attempts may have stopped, but a simpler plan is more likely to last until your big day.

gain|2|none.ms: Majlis anda beri garisan penamat yang jelas, dan tanpa kelemahan besar, anda mula di tempat yang baik. gain|2|none.en: Your event gives us a clear finish line, and with no big gaps you're starting in a good place. This week, count the weeks to your event and set a small target to check each month. Slow, steady gain with strength training is what looks best on the day.

gain|3|Nutrition.ms: Tenaga untuk kerja dan keluarga bermula dengan bahan api, dan sekarang badan anda kekurangan. Minggu ini, bawa satu snek berprotein ke pejabat, contohnya telur rebus, sandwic tuna atau kacang, supaya anda tak pergi 6 jam tanpa makan. Makan yang teratur bantu tenaga lebih stabil, dan kenaikan berat yang perlahan akan menyusul.
gain|3|Nutrition.en: Energy for work and family starts with fuel, and right now your body is running low. This week, pack one protein snack for the office, like boiled eggs, a tuna sandwich or peanuts, so you don't go 6 hours without eating. Regular meals help keep energy steady, and slow weight gain follows.

gain|3|Workout.ms: Dukung anak, angkat barang dapur dan hari kerja yang panjang semuanya lebih mudah bila badan lebih kuat. Minggu ini, buat 15 minit squat, push-up dan lunge, dua kali, mungkin sambil tunggu lauk masak. Kekuatan dan berat naik bersama secara perlahan, jadi fikir dalam bulan, bukan hari.
gain|3|Workout.en: Carrying kids, groceries and long workdays all get easier when you're stronger. This week, do 15 minutes of squats, push-ups and lunges, twice, maybe while dinner is cooking. Strength and weight build slowly together, so think in months, not days.

gain|3|Mindset & Method.ms: Tenaga untuk kerja dan keluarga perlukan rehat, sama penting macam makan dan bersenam. Minggu ini, betulkan satu perkara: tiada skrin atas katil, dan tutup lampu pada waktu yang sama setiap malam. Bila stres lebih rendah, lebih mudah nak kekalkan tabiat yang dulu tak bertahan.
gain|3|Mindset & Method.en: Energy for work and family needs rest as much as food and training. This week, fix one thing: no screens in bed, and lights out at the same time every night. When stress is lower, it's easier to keep the habits that didn't stick before.

gain|3|none.ms: Nak kuat untuk keluarga adalah sebab yang tahan lama, dan tiada kelemahan besar yang melambatkan anda. Minggu ini, tambah satu sesi latihan kekuatan dan satu hidangan protein tambahan sehari, kemudian perhatikan tenaga anda. Kenaikan perlahan dan konsisten dalam beberapa bulan, itulah rentak yang realistik.
gain|3|none.en: Wanting to be strong for your family is a reason that lasts, and nothing major is slowing you down. This week, add one strength session and one extra protein serving a day, then notice how your energy feels. Slow, steady gain over the coming months is the realistic pace.

gain|4|Nutrition.ms: Ada orang yang sayangkan anda, mungkin juga doktor, yang galakkan anda naik berat, jadi jadikan ia matlamat anda sendiri, dan kalau doktor terlibat, teruskan ikut nasihatnya. Minggu ini, tambah satu senduk nasi dan satu protein lagi, contohnya telur atau seketul ayam, waktu makan tengah hari. Tambahan kecil yang konsisten bawa kenaikan yang perlahan dan stabil.
gain|4|Nutrition.en: Someone who cares about you, maybe your doctor, nudged you to gain, so let's make it your goal too, and if a doctor is involved, keep following their advice. This week, add one extra scoop of rice and one extra protein, like an egg or a piece of chicken, at lunch. Small, steady additions lead to slow, steady gain.

gain|4|Workout.ms: Bagus ada orang rapat, atau doktor, yang ambil berat tentang anda, dan kalau doktor terlibat, teruskan ikut nasihatnya. Minggu ini, belajar tiga gerakan asas, squat, push-up dan row, dan buat dua kali, supaya berat yang naik jadi kekuatan. Jangkakan kemajuan yang perlahan dan konsisten dalam beberapa bulan.
gain|4|Workout.en: It's good that someone close, or your doctor, is looking out for you, and if a doctor is involved, keep following their advice. This week, learn three basic moves, squat, push-up and row, and do them twice, so the weight you gain becomes strength. Expect slow, steady progress over months.

gain|4|Mindset & Method.ms: Bila dorongan datang daripada orang lain, cari juga sebab anda sendiri, dan kalau doktor terlibat, teruskan ikut nasihatnya. Minggu ini, tulis kenapa naik berat penting untuk anda, dan tetapkan satu waktu tidur yang tetap. Cubaan lepas mungkin tak kekal, tapi pergi lebih perlahan dan ringkas beri anda peluang yang lebih baik.
gain|4|Mindset & Method.en: When the push comes from someone else, it helps to find your own reason too, and if a doctor is involved, keep following their advice. This week, write down why gaining matters to you and set one fixed bedtime. Past attempts may not have stuck, but going slower and simpler gives you a better chance.

gain|4|none.ms: Orang rapat, atau doktor, perasan anda perlu naik berat, dan kalau doktor terlibat, teruskan ikut nasihatnya. Tiada kelemahan besar, jadi mula dengan catat makanan anda selama tiga hari minggu ini, supaya kita nampak di mana boleh tambah. Lepas itu, sasarkan kenaikan perlahan dan konsisten dengan latihan kekuatan.
gain|4|none.en: Someone close, or your doctor, noticed you need to gain, and if a doctor is involved, keep following their advice. Nothing major stands out, so start by noting your meals for three days this week so we can see where to add more. Then aim for slow, steady gain with strength training.
